KINO | ScreenKey

Location: Remote, U.S. or Canada

Type: Full-time

Experience: Junior to mid-level

Reports to: Head of Sales


About KINO

KINO is building the secure workflow layer for film and television.

Our platform, ScreenKey, helps studios, production companies, distributors, and filmmakers manage dailies, screeners, photo approvals, content review, and distribution in one secure system. We replace fragmented legacy tools with a simpler, more connected workflow built specifically for the entertainment industry.


In under a year, we’ve signed some of the most well-known studios in the world. We’re backed by investors including Sequoia Scout and ARK Invest, and we’re now expanding our sales team to support the next stage of growth.


The Role

We’re hiring an SDR to help us create new relationships across the film and television industry.

You’ll research target accounts, identify the right decision-makers, and start thoughtful conversations with studios, production companies, distributors, sales agents, and other media organizations. You’ll work closely with our Head of Sales and founding team to test messaging, improve our outbound strategy, and build a repeatable pipeline.


This is not a role for someone who wants to send hundreds of generic emails. Entertainment is a relationship-driven industry. We need someone curious, persistent, highly organized, and able to make outreach feel informed and personal.


What You’ll Do
  • Research target companies, productions, and key decision-makers
  • Generate qualified opportunities through email, phone, LinkedIn, industry events, and creative outbound campaigns
  • Build personalized outreach based on each prospect’s role, projects, and current workflow
  • Re-engage past conversations, inactive leads, and existing industry relationships
  • Qualify prospects based on their needs, authority, timing, and fit for ScreenKey
  • Book and prepare qualified meetings for the sales team and founders
  • Maintain accurate activity, account, and opportunity data in our CRM
  • Test new messaging, audiences, and outreach channels
  • Share insights from prospects to improve our positioning, product, and sales strategy
  • Consistently meet activity, meeting, and pipeline targets


You May Be a Great Fit If
  • You enjoy starting conversations and are not discouraged by rejection
  • You write clear, personable emails that do not sound automated!!!
  • You are comfortable speaking with senior executives and industry professionals
  • You are naturally curious and willing to deeply research an account before reaching out
  • You are highly organized and reliable with follow-up
  • You are comfortable working in a fast-moving startup where processes are still being built
  • You take feedback well and actively look for ways to improve
  • You care about hitting your own goals while helping the broader team succeed


Experience We Value
  • 1–3 years of experience in sales, business development, production, post-production, studio coordination, distribution, or a related field
  • Familiarity with film and television production workflows, hierarchy, and terminology
  • Experience with outbound prospecting, CRM systems, and sales engagement tools
  • A background at a studio, production company, post facility, distributor, agency, or entertainment technology company is a major advantage
  • Existing entertainment industry relationships are helpful, but not required


A traditional SaaS sales background is not mandatory. We are equally interested in someone coming from film or television production who understands the industry and is hungry to build a career in sales.


What Success Looks Like

Within 30 days:

You understand ScreenKey, our customers, our target market, and the problems we solve. You are comfortable with our tools, messaging, and sales process.


Within 60 days:

You can independently research accounts, identify decision-makers, communicate ScreenKey’s value, and begin booking qualified meetings.


Within 90 days:

You are consistently running outbound campaigns, hitting activity expectations, booking qualified meetings, and contributing meaningful pipeline.


Why Join KINO

You’ll join a small team at an important stage of growth, with direct access to the founders and meaningful input into how our sales function is built. You’ll learn enterprise sales inside one of the most relationship-driven industries in the world and have a clear opportunity to grow into a larger sales role as the company scales.


This structure borrows the strongest elements from the examples you shared, particularly the emphasis on thoughtful outbound experimentation, clear measures of success, close sales collaboration, and a practical 30/60/90-day plan.

About (Re)vive

Retail is changing, and returns are the problem nobody solved. (Re)vive recovers damaged and returned inventory for premium fashion brands and turns it into revenue through resale, live commerce, and 3P marketplace channels. We’re not liquidation — we’re a recurring revenue channel that protects brand equity while recapturing value that used to get written off.

We’ve spent years building deep merchant and marketplace expertise. We’re partnered with eBay, backed by Madrona (Series A), and positioned to 10x revenue year over year. This is a chance to own space in an emerging category that will change how people shop.

The Role

You’ll be our founding Account Executive — the second dedicated seller on the team, working directly with our Head of Sales. We need a powerhouse AE (equal parts hunter and closer) to drive top of funnel: run high-velocity outbound, build and manage your own pipeline, and close deals that become long-term partnerships, not one-time episodic transactions. You set the expectations, communicate (Re)vive’s value prop, get the MSA signed, and deliver a clean handoff to onboarding.

You won’t do it alone. GTM has the full support of our product and marketplace teams to supercharge growth, and your Head of Sales will remove roadblocks so you have the tools to sell and bring on new brands every day. Your job is to close — ours is to make sure nothing gets in your way.

We need someone who makes an impact in the first week, not the first quarter.

What You’ll Do

  • Own new brand acquisition end to end: prospect, pitch, negotiate, close

  • Own the handoff: capture all inputs required for a smooth transition to onboarding, with MSA signed and expectations set

  • Equity — early enough to matter
  • Female founded
  • Healthcare coverage

  • A front-row seat at a Series A company defining a new category

Cannabis is where we started, and where we became the fastest-growing regulated retail technology company in the country.Flowhub powers compliance, point-of-sale (POS), payments, e-commerce, inventory management, loyalty, and analytics for thousands of cannabis retailers nationwide. He desperately needed it, and found others did too. Flowhub was born. Back in 2014, before most of the industry existed, he became the first to integrate with the state's Metrc tracking system, lobbying Colorado to open the API that's now an industry standard. Our board includes Blake Irving, who, as CEO, took GoDaddy from a few thousand customers to more than 20 million. We're a founding member of the US Cannabis Roundtable (USCR), the lobbying and advocacy group working to normalize and professionalize the market at the federal level.This is an inflection point. POS-native e-commerce launched in 2025, marketing came with it, and our 2026 brand evolution positions Flowhub as the regulated retail technology company it has always been, with a roadmap into adjacent verticals where age-gated, compliance-heavy operators need a platform they can actually run on.We hire people, not resumes. If this role excites you and you think you'd be great at it, please apply.Flowhub is an equal opportunity employer. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic. Need accommodations during the application or interview process? Reach out to us at hrteam@flowhub.com.

  • Roughly 2+ years closing in an Account Executive role, ideally in B2B SaaS. Royce cares more about instincts and results than years on paper, so treat this as a guide, not a gate.
  • A track record of excellence. You've been at or near the top of a sales board, and you can point to deals you won and explain why.
  • Comfort in Salesforce and Outreach, or similar CRM and sales-engagement tools, for running pipeline and staying organized.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a follow-up that moves a deal forward and hold your own on a live call.
  • A genuine interest in sales as a craft, and a commitment to getting better at it.
  • Bonus if you bring it. Existing relationships with cannabis operators or dispensaries, time selling into retail or another tightly regulated industry, or fluency with a deal-qualification framework like MEDDIC or BANT.

🔑 The Hiring Process: Meet the Team

We respect your time. Each conversation should give you a clearer picture of whether this is the right move for you.

  • Stage 1 (Recruiter Screen): A 30-minute conversation with Aaron Friedman, our talent acquisition partner, on your background, what you're looking for, and mutual fit.
  • Stage 2 (Sales Team Connect): A 30-minute conversation with Olivia Self, Sales Team Lead, on how you operate and where you'd fit on the team.
  • Stage 3 (AE Panel): A working session with Josh Brook, Tanner Cosens, and Collin Bannister, Account Executives on the team, digging into how you sell and how you'd run a deal here.
  • Stage 4 (Leadership Connect, On-Site): A visit to our Coconut Grove HQ to spend time with Royce Luque, VP of Sales and the hiring manager for this role, and Will Zinsmeister, our Chief of Staff, and get a feel for the space you'd work in. Plan for roughly 30 to 45 minutes.

Total time from first conversation to offer: roughly two weeks for a strong candidate.

🌟 What's In It For You

  • Compensation 💰: $75K–$90K base and $160K–$185K OTE calibrated to experience, plus equity in a profitable, well-funded company.
  • Full Benefits 🛡: Medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, and 401(k).
  • Time Off 🌴: Unlimited PTO and paid holidays.
  • Where You'll Work 📍: On-site at our Coconut Grove HQ in Miami, five days a week, with regular travel within your territory (at least monthly) for trade shows, live demos, and dispensary visits.
  • The Upside ⚡: This is the chance to help define how an entire category gets sold, with qualified pipeline handed to you and a VP of Sales invested in coaching you up. You close on a platform operators already trust, at a profitable company a decade in, backed by serious people. Close well and the runway to bigger deals and more ownership is yours to earn. High ceiling, solid ground underneath you.

⭐ Our Values

  • Mission-First. We're here to solve real problems for the operators we serve, not to chase what's trending.
  • Maximum Urgency. Speed compounds. We act now, not later.
  • Own It. No spectators. Everyone runs their part of the field.
  • Championship Team. High bar, full trust, no carry-on talent.
  • Efficient Execution. We scale process with technology, not headcount.
  • Dispensary Obsessed. The retailer is the boss. Their problem is our problem.
  • Positive Intent. We assume the best of each other and earn the right to disagree well.

🌿 About Flowhub

Flowhub builds the technology that runs regulated retail. We exist to solve the hardest operational and compliance problems in American commerce, the ones that decide whether a business in a tightly regulated market clears its first audit or its hundredth. Cannabis is where we started, and where we became the fastest-growing regulated retail technology company in the country.

Flowhub powers compliance, point-of-sale (POS), payments, e-commerce, inventory management, loyalty, and analytics for thousands of cannabis retailers nationwide. We process more than $4 billion in our customers' sales each year, achieved profitability in 2023 (a milestone almost no one else in this category has reached), and help high-volume dispensaries automate operations, grow revenue, and deliver a better customer experience.

Founder and CEO Kyle Sherman built Flowhub from the inside out. As a Head of Compliance at early cannabis companies, he ran headfirst into the inefficiencies of existing platforms and set out to create software that would accelerate workflows, increase accuracy, and simplify compliance. He desperately needed it, and found others did too. Flowhub was born. Back in 2014, before most of the industry existed, he became the first to integrate with the state's Metrc tracking system, lobbying Colorado to open the API that's now an industry standard. Kyle still sets the company's vision and strategy.

Flowhub is privately held and backed since the start by serious capital and serious people. Our investors include PayPal, Headline, Poseidon, Shawn "Jay-Z" Carter, Evolv Ventures (the Kraft Heinz Company's venture arm), and the founders of Venmo. Our board includes Blake Irving, who, as CEO, took GoDaddy from a few thousand customers to more than 20 million. We're a founding member of the US Cannabis Roundtable (USCR), the lobbying and advocacy group working to normalize and professionalize the market at the federal level.

This is an inflection point. POS-native e-commerce launched in 2025, marketing came with it, and our 2026 brand evolution positions Flowhub as the regulated retail technology company it has always been, with a roadmap into adjacent verticals where age-gated, compliance-heavy operators need a platform they can actually run on.

We hire people, not resumes. If this role excites you and you think you'd be great at it, please apply.

Flowhub is an equal opportunity employer. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic. Need accommodations during the application or interview process? Reach out to us at hrteam@flowhub.com.

About Kana

Kana is the agentic marketing platform built for the AI era. Founded by the team behind Rapt (acquired by Microsoft) and Krux (acquired by Salesforce for $700M), Kana emerged from stealth in February 2026 with $15M in seed funding led by Mayfield.

We deploy customizable AI agents that integrate with marketers' existing stacks rather than replacing them. Our platform handles campaign management, customer engagement, marketing intelligence, synthetic data generation, answer engine optimization, and media proposal generation – giving marketing teams a "third path" between building from scratch and buying off-the-shelf. We believe in augmented intelligence: AI that amplifies marketers, not replaces them.

We're a small, senior team building deliberately. This is a ground-floor opportunity to shape Kana's GTM motion alongside two founders who have done this before.

The Role

We're hiring a Founding Account Executive – the first dedicated seller at Kana. You'll work directly with the CRO and the founders to take a thoughtful, founder-led sales motion and turn it into a repeatable one. This is a build role, not a plug-and-play role.

In your first six months, you'll:

  • Own full-cycle sales for Kana's agentic marketing platform, from prospecting through close
  • Partner with the founders on early enterprise deals and translate what's working into a repeatable playbook
  • Help shape Kana's ICP, messaging, and sales process based on real market signal
  • Build pipeline through outbound, your own network, and partnerships
  • Sell into CMOs, heads of growth, marketing operations leaders, and data/analytics buyers at mid-market and enterprise consumer brands, media companies, and consumer-tech companies
  • Work cross-functionally with Engineering, and Marketing to inform product direction and positioning

Who You Are

You're a builder, not an operator of someone else's playbook. You're energized by ambiguity, comfortable walking into a room with a half-formed deck, and genuinely curious about how AI is reshaping marketing. You've sold complex software to senior buyers before, and you know how to be consultative without being soft – you can challenge a CMO's thinking and earn their trust in the same conversation.

Ideally you have:

  • 4+ years of experience in enterprise or mid-market software sales, ideally at a martech, adtech, CDP, marketing analytics, or AI-native company
  • Experience selling to marketing buyers: CMOs, VPs of Marketing, heads of growth, marketing ops, or data/analytics leaders
  • A track record of consistent quota attainment, with at least one stint at an early-stage company where you helped build the motion
  • Strong written and verbal communication – you can run a discovery call, write a tight follow-up, and present to an executive room

You might also have:

  • A non-traditional path into sales – management consulting, marketing operations, agency strategy, or product marketing backgrounds welcomed
  • Experience selling AI or agentic products, or selling into customers who are still figuring out what AI means for their business
  • A network in the modern martech ecosystem you can activate

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage venture-backed AI company
  • Direct partnership with founders who have built and exited companies
  • The opportunity to define Kana's sales motion from the ground up alongside a small, senior team
  • Health, dental, and vision benefits; flexible PTO; and SF-based collaboration with remote flexibility

Why Join Kana?

We are building the future of "Agentic Marketing," and we need a GTM engine that reflects that. At Kana, you'll have the autonomy to help us write a future-proof GTM playbook. No legacy processes to hold you back, just a clean slate, a powerful mission, and the resources to build the most efficient demand-gen engine in the industry.

Strong equity, base + commission (50/50) with an OTE of $275-300K, full benefits, and an experienced team who understand the ins-and-outs of building a company.

Ready to build the engine? Apply now and tell us about the most complex AI-driven automation you've ever built.

  • Full-Cycle Sales: Run deals from first conversation through close across mid-market and enterprise accounts.

Who You Are

  • Experienced: 2–5+ years in full-cycle sales (early-stage B2B SaaS, CX/support software, or commerce/productivity).

  • Strategist: You understand PLG-to-SLG, land-and-expand strategies, and champion enablement.
  • Channel-Oriented: You have experience (or a strong desire) to build channel, agency, or co-sell relationships.
  • Systems Thinker: You use CRM tools, pipeline management, and AI-powered workflows to multiply your output.
  • Communicator: You can tailor your message to various stakeholders (founders, ops, IT, CTOs) with clarity and empathy.
  • Owner: You have a high sense of ownership and fix what is broken.


Bonus Points

  • Experience selling CX, support, or conversational AI.
  • Existing relationships in the Shopify ecosystem.
  • Experience building a partner/channel program from scratch.
  • Familiarity with usage-based or hybrid pricing models.
  • A network in the startup, VC, or enterprise IT ecosystem


Why Jugl

  • Product-Led: The product does the work, making deals easier to run and reference selling natural.
  • Partner Leverage: Build Shopify and agency/BPO channels that provide scale beyond headcount.
  • Real Ownership: Shape the GTM strategy, pricing, and scaling from day one.
  • High Scope: Work directly with the CEO and founding team on strategy and product development.
  • Momentum: Proven success with live customers and a strong, active DFW startup community.
  • Growth: As the GTM function grows, so does your role into leadership.

New York, NY

OpenYield is an API-first institutional marketplace bringing scalable, systematic execution to fixed income. The platform connects brokerages, advisors, and asset managers with leading electronic market makers, delivering firm, executable pricing across corporate, municipal, and Treasurys. With liquidity from leading market makers including Flow Traders, Virtu, and TD Securities, OpenYield delivers $25B+ in live inventory to 60+ brokerages, advisors, and asset managers representing more than $5 trillion in client assets.

The role

We're hiring our first dedicated sales hire — a founding originator to generate commercial traction now and build the GTM function around themselves over time. This is a hunter seat. You'll run the top of the funnel, drive full-cycle deals, and personally sign the brokerages, advisory platforms, asset managers, and dealers that will shape OpenYield's next chapter. You'll also help us productize and sell our data services across the buy-side and sell-side.

This is a build-by-doing seat. There is no team to manage yet — you create the playbook by closing deals, and you grow the team around you once the motion is proven. Day one is about generating pipeline and signing logos. Over time, this seat can scale into a leadership role as the company grows. The ceiling on the role is the ceiling of the company.

You'll work directly with the founder and product/engineering leadership. We have a foundation to build on — live customers, real pipeline, a CRM, working systems — but the function is yours to shape. You'll keep what works, rip out what doesn't, and codify the way OpenYield sells from here.

What you'll do

  • Originate. Prospect into brokerages, RIAs, asset managers, dealers, and data buyers — by phone, email, Bloomberg IB chat, in person, and through your network. You manufacture your own pipeline.
  • Close. Run full-cycle deals from first touch through technical eval, integration scoping, contract, and go-live.
  • Sell across the stack: trading access, platform integrations, and data licenses.
  • Sharpen the motion. Refine our ICPs, segment the market, tighten the pitch, and instrument the funnel.
  • Translate market signal into product. You'll be the closest seat to our customers — what you hear should shape the roadmap.
  • Represent OpenYield with senior buy-side and sell-side counterparties — heads of trading, fixed income tech leads, COOs, CIOs.
  • Forecast accurately and report cleanly to the executive team.

What we're looking for

Non-negotiable — you manufacture your own pipeline. You can point to specific deals where you sourced the first meeting yourself: cold, through your network, or by being resourceful. Logos you personally originated and closed, not inherited or fed to you by inbound. This matters more than seniority, title history, or years in seat.

Must-have

  • Roughly 5–10 years selling into capital markets — fixed income preferred, but strong equities, derivatives, or market data backgrounds welcome. What you've actually closed and how you operate matters more than the year count.
  • Enough credibility and network to get a head of trading, COO, or fixed income tech lead on the phone — and the hunger to still do the prospecting yourself.
  • Working fluency in trading workflows and how a platform plugs into a brokerage or asset manager.
  • Early-stage temperament. You're energized by ambiguity, you ship without a manager telling you to, and you can build the function while you're hitting your number.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication — you can explain a fixed income microstructure problem to a CTO and an API integration to a head of trading.
  • Willingness to travel for customer meetings, conferences, and industry events.

Bonus

  • Deeper technical depth: OMS/EMS integrations, FIX, APIs.
  • Comfort selling data products in addition to platform access, and selling to both the buy-side and sell-side.
  • Tech-forward and AI-native — you already use LLMs daily and have wired together tools to compound your own output. Capital markets sales is changing fast, and we like people who'd rather build a workflow than do the same thing twice.

Why this seat

Fixed income is in the middle of its biggest structural change in 25 years, and OpenYield is one of a small number of companies actually rebuilding the infrastructure underneath it. You'd own the founding sales seat at a venture-backed startup with real distribution, real volume, real backing from the largest market makers on the planet, and a long runway to build the franchise.

What we offer

  • New York City preferred. We operate in a high-bandwidth environment where proximity to the founder, leadership, customers, and market helps us move faster. We have flexibility for the right person.
  • Meaningful equity. This is a founding commercial hire, and the equity reflects it. Cash rewards production; equity is where you build real upside as the franchise grows.
  • Ownership. You will define the GTM motion, shape the product roadmap through customer signal, and build the commercial foundation for the company.
  • A fast, open, truth-seeking culture. We value direct communication, intellectual honesty, high standards, and people who care more about getting to the right answer than being right.
  • A front-row seat to the modernization of the second-largest asset class in the world.

Compensation

In accordance with New York City's Pay Transparency Law, the base salary range for this role is $160,000 to $200,000, plus uncapped variable compensation tied to commercial performance, The role also includes meaningful equity. Placement within the range is dependent on level of experience. Base salary does not include other forms of compensation or benefits.

OpenYield is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds. For more information, please visit www.openyld.com.

description: The roleAs Taktile scales its enterprise motion, consulting partnerships have become one of our highest-priority GTM levers. The world's leading strategy and implementation firms are deeply embedded in the AI and risk transformation projects happening at our target accounts — and when they recommend or co-deliver with Taktile, the entire sales dynamic changes: faster access, bigger deals, stronger retention.We have active partner relationships, clear targets, and a proven approach — but this is still early days, and there's a lot left to figure out. We need someone who can own the execution, help drive a portfolio of partnerships from early engagement through to joint pipeline and formalized go-to-market, and help shape the motion as we learn.What you'll doIdentify and activate champions inside target firms — practice leads and partners who own client relationships in financial servicesTravel regularly to build and deepen partner relationshipsRun structured account mapping sessions and open 2–3 active deal threads per firmCo-deliver the first joint client engagements (our "customer zero" moments) that generate case studies, trust, and internal proof inside the partner firmEnable partner teams on Taktile's platform and joint solution narrativeFormalize relationships with clear KPIs, referral agreements, and co-marketing commitments once deal flow is provenOwn a partnerships pipeline target and report on leading indicators (champions activated, streams open, joint pitches in flight)Collaborate with marketing on joint assets: white papers, co-branded events, thought leadershipFeed intelligence from partner conversations back into product and sales — you'll often know about customer initiatives before we doWhat we're looking forBackground: a high-agency generalist and strong relationship builder with 3–6 years of experience, ideally with investing (Tier-1 fund) or consulting (MBB or Big 4) background followed by a commercial role at a high-growth B2B software companyBuilder mentality: You're energized by ambiguity, not paralyzed by it. You'll help build the playbook, not inherit itCommercial instinct: You understand what drives a consulting partner's incentives and can speak that language crediblyStructured thinker: You can manage 5–6 relationships at different stages simultaneously and know which levers to pull on eachWhy now, why TaktileWe're at the inflection point where partnerships becomes a meaningful GTM motion. We have active threads with almost every major firm, a new CRO who has built partnership programs before and believes in them, and joint wins within reach. You'd be joining before it's obvious, which means you'll own the narrative.What we offerWork with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here. Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company. Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo. Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe. Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set-up. Our StanceWe're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply. We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator.   • Identify and activate champions inside target firms — practice leads and partners who own client relationships in financial services
  • Travel regularly to build and deepen partner relationships
  • Run structured account mapping sessions and open 2–3 active deal threads per firm
  • Co-deliver the first joint client engagements (our "customer zero" moments) that generate case studies, trust, and internal proof inside the partner firm
  • Enable partner teams on Taktile's platform and joint solution narrative
  • Formalize relationships with clear KPIs, referral agreements, and co-marketing commitments once deal flow is proven
  • Own a partnerships pipeline target and report on leading indicators (champions activated, streams open, joint pitches in flight)
  • Collaborate with marketing on joint assets: white papers, co-branded events, thought leadership
  • Feed intelligence from partner conversations back into product and sales — you'll often know about customer initiatives before we do

What we're looking for

  • Background: a high-agency generalist and strong relationship builder with 3–6 years of experience, ideally with investing (Tier-1 fund) or consulting (MBB or Big 4) background followed by a commercial role at a high-growth B2B software company
  • Builder mentality: You're energized by ambiguity, not paralyzed by it. You'll help build the playbook, not inherit it
  • Commercial instinct: You understand what drives a consulting partner's incentives and can speak that language credibly
  • Structured thinker: You can manage 5–6 relationships at different stages simultaneously and know which levers to pull on each

Why now, why Taktile

We're at the inflection point where partnerships becomes a meaningful GTM motion. We have active threads with almost every major firm, a new CRO who has built partnership programs before and believes in them, and joint wins within reach. You'd be joining before it's obvious, which means you'll own the narrative.

What we offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.
  • Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company.
  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.
  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.
  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.
  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.
  • Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.
  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

California residents have additional rights under the CCPA, including the right to know, delete, and correct personal information.

Automated decision-making: We use automated tools to assist in screening applications. No hiring decision is made solely by automated means without human review.

International transfers: Your data may be transferred to and processed in the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, or Romania. Where required, transfers are protected by Standard Contractual Clauses or other approved mechanisms.

descriptionHtml:
Chief Executive Officer (Founding CEO)

Construction Change Order Verification Platform | Location: Remote-first (US) | Type: Full-time | Stage: Seed / Early | Reports to: Founder / Board


We’re looking for a founding CEO to take a market-ready construction-tech SaaS platform from launch to scale — owning revenue, leading an in-place commercial team, and partnering directly with the founder on the next raise.


About the Company


We are an early-stage SaaS company solving one of real estate development’s most persistent and costly pain points: the change order. For owner/developers, change orders represent a constant source of budget risk, schedule slippage, and contract disputes — with verification and approval processes that still rely heavily on email, spreadsheets, and manual coordination.

Our platform gives owner/developers a structured, audit-ready system to verify, track, and approve change orders across their projects — reducing exposure, accelerating decisions, and creating a defensible record at every stage. Our MVP is in final development, our pricing model is established, and we are building the commercial team to bring the product to market. We are seeking a founding CEO to lead that charge.


The Opportunity


This role is built for a hands-on CEO who can lead from launch to scale. The product is market-ready, the pricing model is in place, and the core team is onboard. Your job is to direct that team, own the revenue number, and drive the company forward from early revenue.

The founding team remains actively engaged: the founder leads investor relationships and product strategy, and a fractional CTO anchors the technical roadmap. This role is squarely focused on commercial execution, team leadership, and operational scale. At seed stage, the CEO also carries CFO and COO responsibilities — managing finances, burn, and operational infrastructure — until dedicated hires are warranted.


What You’ll Do


Commercial Leadership & Team Management

  • Directly manage and provide day-to-day direction to the Account Executives and Marketing Manager, until a director of sales is warranted and onboarded
  • Set revenue targets, activity metrics, and accountability structures for the commercial team
  • Coach the AE through the full sales cycle — from prospecting owner/developer accounts to close
  • Direct the marketing function: positioning, content, demand generation, and brand presence in the owner/developer segment
  • Build repeatable sales and marketing playbooks as the team scales

Revenue & Go-to-Market

  • Own and drive the GTM strategy targeting owner/developers — developers, family offices, REITs, and institutional project owners
  • Lead the commercial launch alongside the existing team, converting early design partners into paying customers
  • Leverage the established pricing model to build a scalable, repeatable sales motion
  • Identify and pursue channel partnerships, industry associations, and referral networks within the owner/developer community

Investor Relations & Fundraising Support

  • Partner closely with the founder on Series A preparation — provide commercial traction, pipeline metrics, and go-to-market narrative
  • Manage investor updates, board reporting, and financial communications
  • Support due diligence processes and relationship-building with prospective investors

Product & Customer Collaboration

  • Serve as the voice of the customer — translate owner/developer feedback into actionable product priorities
  • Collaborate with the fractional CTO and product team to align the roadmap with near-term commercial needs
  • Maintain tight feedback loops between early customers and the development team through and after MVP launch

Finance & Operations (CFO/COO duties at seed stage)

  • Manage company finances: budget, burn rate, cash runway, and capital allocation
  • Oversee financial infrastructure — accounting, payroll, expense management, and forecasting
  • Build operating processes and documentation to support the next stage of growth
  • Ensure legal, compliance, and vendor/contract foundations are in place


What We’re Looking For


Required

  • 5+ years of operating experience in B2B SaaS — ideally in a founder, GM, COO, or VP-level role with direct revenue responsibility
  • Proven ability to manage, coach, and hold accountable a commercial team (sales and/or marketing)
  • Track record in early-stage environments: commercial launches, 0-to-1 GTM execution, or seed-to-Series A transitions
  • Deep familiarity with the owner/developer segment — real estate developers, project owners, family offices, or institutional capital in the built environment
  • Financial acumen: budgeting, burn management, financial modeling, and investor reporting
  • Collaborative working style — able to operate effectively alongside a hands-on founder

Preferred

  • Prior CEO, COO, or President experience at a SaaS, PropTech, or ConTech company
  • Experience directing both sales and marketing functions simultaneously in a resource-constrained environment
  • Existing network of C-suite candidates and critical hires
  • Existing network among owner/developers, development managers, ownership groups, or real estate investment firms
  • Familiarity with construction project management from the owner’s perspective: change orders, budget contingency, draw schedules, and project controls
  • Experience supporting or co-leading venture fundraising processes (Seed through Series A/B)


Compensation & Benefits


Compensation is structured to attract a mission-aligned executive at seed stage — meaningful equity, competitive cash, and the operational authority to build something significant alongside an engaged founding team.

  • Competitive base salary (cash/equity mix discussed based on candidate preference)
  • Significant founding equity grant with standard vesting schedule
  • Full benefits package (health, dental, vision)
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment
  • Immediate team to lead — Account Executive and Marketing Manager in place at start

Why Dealops?

AI’s transforming how companies price, sell and scale. The shift towards outcome-based, usage-based, and hybrid pricing models has unlocked a $25B+ market, demanding smarter solutions across pricing, deal execution, and sales compensation. Led by ex-Stripe operators and backed by Pear VC, General Catalyst, and execs from OpenAI, Stripe and Slack with $7M in funding, Dealops is a pioneering AI‑driven platform that enables flexible pricing, streamline workflows and boost sales performance.

The opportunity

As our Founding Account Manager, you'll own the post-sale relationship with the most innovative AI and enterprise software companies building on Dealops. Once a customer signs, you're the person who makes them successful, sticky, and growing. You'll own retention, drive expansion, and turn early adopters into champions who can't imagine running pricing without us.

This is our first dedicated post-sale hire. You won't inherit a playbook for renewals, QBRs, or expansion motions, you'll write it. You'll partner directly with our CEO and GTM lead to define what world-class account management looks like at Dealops and build the foundation for how we retain and grow revenue as we scale.

This is an in-person role based in our San Francisco office.

If you've thrived in early-stage, high-ownership roles and are excited to own a book of business from day one while building the systems others will run on, this is your moment.

  • Full-ownership of the book – retention, expansion, and renewals end-to-end, no hand-offs
  • Founding CS/AM impact – build the playbooks for onboarding, QBRs, and expansion
  • Customer obsession – partner with Heads of Pricing, RevOps, and Finance to drive real value
  • Cross-functional partnership – feed customer insights directly into Product and GTM bets

What you'll own

  • Build the AM playbook: Codify what works, onboarding flows, expansion triggers, health scoring, renewal motions, into repeatable systems the team will scale on.
  • Deepen customer relationships: Become the trusted advisor to Heads of Pricing, RevOps, and Finance leaders. Run QBRs, executive check-ins, and health reviews that keep Dealops embedded in how they operate.
  • Drive expansion: Identify whitespace across usage, teams, and use cases. Build the upsell and cross-sell motion that grows accounts from first contract to enterprise-wide deployment.
  • Collaborate deeply: Work hand-in-hand with GTM, Product, and Engineering to close expansion deals, resolve issues fast, and turn customer feedback into roadmap bets.

What Makes You a Fit

  • 3–5 years in a client-facing role such as Account Management, Customer Success, or post-sale ownership at a fast-growing B2B SaaS or AI startup
  • Proven track record owning retention and expansion, carrying a renewal or NRR/quota number and hitting it
  • Experience growing mid-market or enterprise accounts and navigating multi-stakeholder relationships across RevOps, Finance, and Sales
  • Exceptional business intuition and the ability to connect product capabilities to customer outcomes
  • Excited by the ambiguity and pace of early-stage environments; you thrive when building from zero
  • Bonus: Experience with B2B Pricing, CPQ, GTM, or RevOps tools — but attitude and curiosity beat exact background

What we offer

  • Competitive salary + early stage equity
  • Medical, dental, vision
  • Unlimited PTO (really)
  • Daily team lunch & snacks

WHY WE EXIST

Money should move as easily as data. It doesn't today — but technology is finally catching up to what customers expect: instant, global, programmable money. HIFI exists to fix that. Our mission is to make money programmable by default, and to give developers and businesses the tools to move value at software speed.

THE ROLE

As a Senior Account Executive at HIFI, you'll own the full sales cycle — from first conversation to signed contract — with fintech platforms, marketplaces, neobanks, payroll providers, and enterprises building the next generation of global money movement.

This is a technical sale. Our customers are builders and decision-makers who care deeply about infrastructure, reliability, and compliance. You'll earn their trust by understanding their problems, not by reciting a pitch deck. You'll work closely with our engineering and GTM teams to navigate complex deals and close business that lasts.

We bias toward motion. Pipelines don't build themselves. If you touch it, you own it — that's how we work.

What You'll Build

  • Run the full sales cycle end-to-end — prospecting, discovery, demos, proposals, negotiation, and close — for HIFI's stablecoin rails, card programs, and money-movement APIs.
  • Build and manage a pipeline of mid-market and enterprise accounts across fintech, payments, and stablecoin ecosystems — you build it from scratch, not just work inbound.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each customer's architecture, goals, and pain points — and map HIFI's platform to both.
  • Partner with solutions engineering and product to navigate technical evaluations and POCs, and close deals that last.
  • Keep forecasting honest and pipeline hygiene tight in CRM, and feed market intelligence back to product and GTM as the voice of the customer.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of B2B sales with a consistent track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals — ideally in fintech, payments, developer tools, or financial infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated success as an early or founding-stage seller: you build pipeline from scratch and don't wait for inbound.
  • Fluency selling to both technical buyers (engineers, CTOs) and business decision-makers.
  • Clear, direct communicator — in writing, on calls, and in the room.
  • You execute when you commit, and you don't confuse activity with progress.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience selling payments infrastructure, stablecoin products, or banking-as-a-service platforms (Stripe/Bridge, Marqeta, Galileo, Lithic, or similar).
  • An existing network across fintech, crypto, or global payments buyers.
  • Familiarity with payment rails (ACH, SWIFT, SEPA) or stablecoin ecosystems (USDC, USDT, EVM).
  • Prior early-stage startup experience — you know what it means to build a function from zero.

HOW WE WORK

  • Ownership — If you touch it, you own it.
  • Speed — We bias toward motion.
  • Clarity — Confusion is a signal to act.
  • Standards — Quality matters, always.
  • Truth — We value directness without drama.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary range: $100,000–$140,000 USD, with the starting figure depending on location, skills, experience, and internal pay parity.

On top of base, you earn 10% of the net revenue generated by the deals you close — uncapped, with no quota — paid monthly as that revenue is realized. There's no ceiling: your earnings scale directly with the business you bring in and the margin it creates.

As one of our first commercial hires at an early stage, you'll also receive meaningful equity — real ownership in what you're helping build, which is central to how we think about total compensation here. We offer full health coverage (medical, dental, and vision) and unlimited PTO.

We're changing how modern business moves value. If that's the problem you want to spend the next chapter of your career on, we'd love to meet you.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

HIFI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We provide reasonable accommodations during the hiring process.

Compensation Range: $100K - $140K

About Diagonal

Diagonal is building the future of personalized software. Our core team has deep experience in vertical SaaS and crafting systems at scale. We're backed by leading investors and are setting the foundation for a platform that redefines how software adapts to its users.

The Role

We're looking for a Founding Account Executive to help build the foundation of our go-to-market motion.

This is a true early-stage sales role. You won't be handed a mature pipeline or a polished playbook — you'll help create them. We're looking for someone who enjoys the full sales process: sourcing prospects, cold calling, outbound outreach, running demos, and closing deals.

You'll work directly with the founders to shape how Diagonal grows. That means refining messaging, identifying ideal customer profiles, experimenting with outbound strategies, and helping turn early traction into a scalable sales engine.

Our customers are SMB businesses looking for software that adapts to how they operate instead of forcing them into rigid workflows. Your job is to help them understand what's possible and guide them through that transformation.

If you thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy building momentum from scratch, and love the process of winning customers, you'll thrive here.

Responsibilities

  • Own the SMB sales cycle from outbound prospecting through close
  • Source and qualify new opportunities through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, referrals, and creative outbound strategies
  • Run discovery calls and product demos tailored to each customer's workflows and pain points
  • Build and manage your own pipeline while maintaining strong CRM hygiene
  • Work directly with founders to refine messaging, positioning, and outbound strategy
  • Gather customer feedback and help shape both product direction and go-to-market strategy
  • Experiment with outbound tactics, messaging, and sales processes to improve conversion rates
  • Develop a deep understanding of Diagonal's platform and communicate its value clearly to business owners and operators

A Final Note

This role is for someone who wants to help build the sales engine from the ground up — not just plug into an existing machine.

You'll have significant ownership, direct access to the founders, and the opportunity to shape how Diagonal grows. We're looking for someone hungry, resourceful, and excited to create momentum every day.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in SMB sales, outbound sales, or account executive roles at a SaaS company
  • Comfortable prospecting and cold calling consistently
  • Strong discovery and demo skills — able to guide conversations naturally and uncover customer pain points
  • Highly self-directed and organized in a remote environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Competitive, driven, and excited by early-stage environments
  • Ability to move quickly, adapt fast, and wear multiple hats
  • Experience selling vertical SaaS, workflow software, or operational tools is a plus
  • Startup experience is a plus, especially at an early-stage company

Benefits

  • Competitive salary + commission + equity
  • Fully remote team
  • Discretionary PTO
  • US Only: Top-tier Health Insurance (Medical, Vision, Dental)
  • Top-of-the-line computers/equipment
  • Paid parental leave

descriptionHtml:
About Togetherhood

Togetherhood is on a mission to infuse every community with high-quality enrichment and education. We partner with schools and community organizations to deliver exceptional after-school programs, workshops, and educational experiences through a marketplace of outstanding teaching artists and enrichment providers. We operate in New York City, Philadelphia, Boston and Washington DC and are in the process of expanding nationwide.


About the Role

We’re looking for an Accounting Manager who combines strong accounting fundamentals with a passion for improving business operations.


You’ll own our accounting function, ensuring the books remain accurate, timely, and well organized. Beyond accounting, you’ll help improve reporting, automate manual processes, support revenue operations, and contribute to operational initiatives that help Togetherhood scale.


This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys accounting but wants broader business responsibility in a growing startup.


You’ll report to our CEO and work with leaders across the company.


What You'll Own

Accounting (Approximately 50%)

  • Own the monthly close in QuickBooks Online
  • Prepare monthly financial statements
  • Manage accounts payable using Tipalti
  • Monitor accounts receivable using Upflow and resolve exceptions
  • Prepare journal entries and account reconciliations
  • Reconcile bank accounts, payroll, and credit cards
  • Maintain accurate financial records and strong internal controls
  • Coordinate with our external CPA on tax filings, year-end close, and audits


Revenue Operations (Approximately 25%)

  • Calculate and administer sales commissions
  • Work with DOE for metros in which we operate to ensure smooth invoicing, collections and vendor payments
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for partner invoice questions, responding quickly, clearly, and accurately to keep billing on track
  • Maintain commission models and supporting documentation
  • Improve CRM data quality and reporting 
  • Build recurring dashboards and operational reports
  • Support revenue reporting and business analytics


Operations & Systems (Approximately 25%)

  • Help operationalize expansion into new markets
  • Coordinate vendor onboarding and compliance requirements with school districts and government agencies
  • Improve workflows across finance, operations, and customer success
  • Document and standardize business processes
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work
  • Improve workflows using AI and modern software tools
  • Optimize integrations across QuickBooks, HubSpot, Tipalti, Upflow, Stripe, and other business systems


What We're Looking For

  • 3–7 years of accounting experience in a small or growing business 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. (CPA or CPA candidate is a strong plus. if needed)
  • Experience owning bookkeeping and the monthly close
  • Strong QuickBooks Online experience
  • Strong analytical thinking: you can break down a problem, work with data, and reason toward a clear answer
  • Excellent Excel or Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and financial analysis
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Excellent email communication and rapport: you are highly responsive, professional, and able to be firm about payment terms while staying friendly and building trust with partners
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Curiosity and a desire to improve systems and processes
  • Comfort working across multiple functions in a growing company


Bonus Points

Experience with:

  • HubSpot
  • Tipalti
  • Upflow
  • Stripe
  • Startup or high-growth companies
  • Sales commission administration
  • Business process automation
  • AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or Gemini to improve productivity and automate recurring work


Our Ideal Candidate

You enjoy building better systems.

When you encounter a repetitive task, your first instinct is to ask, “How can we automate or improve this?”

You’re comfortable using AI to analyze data, build spreadsheets, document processes, draft communications, and eliminate manual work.

You take ownership, enjoy solving problems, and are excited to expand your impact beyond traditional accounting.


What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will:

  • Maintain an accurate, timely, and predictable monthly close.
  • Ensure our accounting processes continue to operate smoothly as the business grows.
  • Improve commission administration and operational reporting.
  • Introduce automations that reduce manual work and improve accuracy.
  • Help create repeatable operational playbooks as Togetherhood expands into new markets.
  • Become a trusted operational partner to leaders across the company.


Why Togetherhood?

You’ll have the opportunity to own a critical business function while helping shape how a growing company operates and scales. You’ll work directly with leadership, take on meaningful cross-functional projects, and have a visible impact on the future of the business.

About the Role

We connect small business owners seeking financing with the lenders best positioned to help them. As an Account Manager on our Marketplace team, you'll be the primary relationship owner for our lending partners: the banks, online lenders, specialty finance brokers, and SBA lenders who receive business financing leads through our platform. The partnerships you manage directly shape the experience on both sides of the marketplace. When lenders receive well-matched leads and have a smooth, transparent process to work with, small business owners are more likely to find the right financing and get funded. This role is fundamentally about building those partnerships with care, understanding each lender's unique criteria, ensuring they're getting real value from the relationship, and working collaboratively to drive better outcomes for everyone involved.


What You'll Do

  • Serve as the dedicated point of contact for a portfolio of lending partners, building deep, trust-based relationships with their teams
  • Own the performance of your partner accounts, tracking key metrics including conversion rates, contact rates, funded rates, CPL, and CPA to ensure partners are seeing a strong return on their lead spend
  • Collaborate with partners to optimize lead programs by refining targeting criteria, adjusting volume levels, and fine-tuning filters to improve match quality and lower acquisition costs
  • Develop a thorough understanding of each partner's technical setup, including how they receive and process leads, their internal workflows, and any system dependencies that affect campaign performance
  • Troubleshoot API and lead delivery issues in coordination with internal technical teams, serving as the primary point of contact for partners when integration problems arise
  • Identify underperforming accounts and work proactively with partners to diagnose conversion issues and implement changes that improve outcomes
  • Conduct regular business reviews focused on campaign performance, ROI trends, and opportunities to improve efficiency across the lead lifecycle
  • Work with internal teams to test and implement optimizations at the program level, from lead scoring adjustments to delivery timing and volume pacing
  • Act as an internal advocate for your partners, coordinating with operations, product, and finance teams to resolve quality disputes, delivery issues, and billing questions
  • Stay current on trends in small business lending so you can have informed, peer-level conversations with partner contacts
  • Maintain accurate account records, performance notes, and activity logs in the CRM


What We're Looking For

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in account management, affiliate marketing, or lead generation, preferably at a lead marketplace, performance network, or financial services company
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance reports and translate findings into clear, actionable guidance for partners
  • Strong presentation skills with the ability to communicate performance data, insights, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Working knowledge of lead gen economics: CPL, CPA, conversion funnels, lead quality scoring, and return on lead spend
  • Comfortable in conversations with lenders, underwriters, and sales managers about lead performance and program fit
  • Highly organized with excellent follow-through; comfortable managing a portfolio of 20+ active accounts
  • A natural relationship builder who earns trust through consistency, responsiveness, and genuine investment in partner success
  • Ability to travel approximately 5 to 10% of the time for partner meetings, industry events, and team offsites.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $70,000 to $90,000 depending on experience
  • On-Target Earnings: $100,000 to $120,000 with uncapped commission potential
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible PTO and company-wide recharge days

About The Role

We serve some of the most sophisticated financial institutions in the world, and our clients are pulling us deeper into their workflows, expanding the problems they trust us to solve, and asking us to move even faster with them.

That's why we're hiring a Founding Account Manager. You'll quarterback these relationships end-to-end for your assigned accounts, grow our engagement, and build the playbook for how Obin shows up for its most important clients. This is a founding seat — you won't inherit a template, you'll create one.

What You'll Own

  • Own the relationship, end to end. You are the primary point of accountability for a portfolio of marquee institutional clients — from C-suite sponsors to technical counterparts. You orchestrate every touchpoint: QBRs, expansion conversations, escalations, and everything in between.

As an Account Manager at Pylon, you will own commercial outcomes for a defined portfolio of customers in our post-sales base with a focus on expansion revenue, renewals, and strategic account growth. You’ll partner closely with Customer Success Managers to drive revenue while ensuring customers achieve meaningful business results. This role is for a revenue-driven, relationship-focused leader who can balance commercial execution with customer value delivery.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify and drive expansion opportunities within an assigned book of customers
  • Lead renewal discussions and negotiations, ensuring high renewal rates and predictable revenue outcomes
  • Collaborate with CSMs to align health, adoption, and usage insights with commercial strategy
  • Build and execute account plans that increase customer lifetime value and strategic engagement
  • Establish strong, trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across the organization (executives, champions, operators)
  • Maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline, and customer analytics

What Success Looks Like

  • Meeting or exceeding quarterly expansion + renewal revenue targets
  • Strong alignment with CSMs measured by adoption signals and customer satisfaction
  • Clear, executable account growth plans with measurable pipeline and closed revenue
  • Timely and accurate forecasting with disciplined CRM discipline

What You Bring

  • 3+ years in Account Management, Sales, or post-sales roles with quota-carrying experience
  • Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets
  • Strong understanding of multithreading, executive relationship management, and value-based selling
  • Ability to develop deep understanding of complex technical products and translate features into business value for customers
  • Excited to build playbooks to help scale up the AM team
  • Comfortable using CRM and revenue tooling (e.g., Salesforce)
  • Data-driven in identifying, prioritizing, and progressing expansion opportunities within a portfolio

Requirements

  • Location: Based in San Francisco or willing to relocate, with enthusiasm for working in person.
  • Customer Communication: Comfortable interacting with customers daily over chat and video.
  • Analytical Thinking: Able to deeply understand customer use cases and recommend thoughtful, strategic solutions.
  • Operational Discipline: Highly organized, process-oriented, and capable of managing a high-volume workload.
  • Product Curiosity: Interested in exploring product nuances and designing more efficient workflows.
  • Bonus: Experience building or analyzing dashboards in modern analytics tools.

🏦 401(k) retirement plan

🚆 Commuter benefits

🌱 Parental leave

🏝️ 14 company holidays + unlimited PTO

About SuperAnnotate
SuperAnnotate helps the world’s leading AI teams build responsible, next-generation models powered by high-quality human data. We’re a fast-growing Series B startup bridging the gap between advanced AI innovation and the data that drives it. Our global network of expert specialists, scalable managed operations, precise talent matching, and full project transparency ensure unmatched data quality at scale. Trusted by innovators like Databricks and ServiceNow - and backed by NVIDIA, Dell Technologies Capital, Databricks Ventures, Cox Enterprises, and Lionel Messi’s Play Time VC - SuperAnnotate is proud to be the top-ranked AI data company on G2 for multiple consecutive years, including 2025.

The Impact You'll Make
We are looking for an experienced, driven and enthusiastic Global Account Director who can guide our prospects and customers through their buying journey with SuperAnnotate. You will be working directly with the sales management and founding team daily, and be expected to have a critical impact on the organization and on its revenue.

It will be critical for this candidate to be someone who has an entrepreneurial mindset, thinks strategically, wants to build as much as sell, can prospect as well as close deals, and is willing to get his/her hands dirty.

This is a full-time, hybrid position based in San Francisco.

What You'll Do

  • Develop pipeline using demand generation, prospecting tools, professional networking, and enterprise selling methodology
  • Build account plans and manage a territory of target enterprises training and deploying frontier AI models
  • Explore & identify new opportunities in new accounts and expansion of existing accounts, including new use cases, data types, and modalities within current customers
  • Research and present business intelligence about customers' and prospects' model development roadmaps, data needs, and where human data services fit into their pipeline
  • Scope and shape services engagements, including specialized labeling workforces, data pipelines, and project structures aligned to customer model needs
  • Help develop and continuously improve our prospecting and selling motions
  • Own deals from prospect to close, and maintain relationship with delivery/customer success through renewals and expansions




What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience selling and generating demand for enterprise services, with strong preference for candidates who have sold data services, managed services, or professional services into AI/ML buyers
  • Experience and relationships selling to executives and teams training frontier AI models at organizations such as Google, Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic, Apple, Meta, etc.
  • Previous experience selling into AI/ML, data labeling, data annotation, RLHF, or related human-data services required
  • Comfort selling complex, high-touch services deals where pricing, scope, and delivery model are negotiated and customized per account, rather than a standard licensing motion
  • High business acumen and ability to sell technology and business value to all levels of an organization including individual contributors, mid-level management, and C-level executives
  • Experience with MEDDICC and enterprise selling methodologies such as Command of the Message
  • Consistent track record of exceeding quota
  • Strong ability to succeed in multi-channel pipeline generation including inbound discovery calls, outbound prospecting, working with SDRs and working with partners

  • Self-starter and independent worker, ambitious and takes initiative
  • An attentive listener, quick study, and skilled influencer
  • Strong customer presence, with polish and dedication to customer outcomes

What We Offer

  • Attractive base salary with significant stock options offering an ownership stake in the company's success
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Flexible paid time off, holidays, and parental leave policies

About Scytale

Scytale is a global leader, an AI-powered company transforming how organizations achieve and maintain trust and compliance. Our platform automates frameworks SOC 2, ISO 27001, SOX ITGC, GDPR, PCI DSS, and 60+ more frameworks, making compliance smarter, faster, and continuously audit-ready. 

Built for startups, scale-ups, and enterprises, Scytale combines intelligent automation, real-time monitoring, and AI-driven insights to reduce manual work and eliminate compliance blind spots. Recognized as a G2 Leader in GRC and an AWS Rising Star Partner of the Year, Scytale is trusted by hundreds of companies worldwide and known for its technology and partnership-driven approach. And we are now expanding into the United States - our most important growth market. We’re looking for a founding US hire to lead this expansion.


﻿The Role

This is not a traditional sales role. As our GTM Lead, you will be Scytale's first boots-on-the-ground seller in the country, helping us establish our presence - owning everything from pipeline generation to closing deals, testing partnerships, and shaping our go-to-market strategy. You’ll operate as a mini-GM with a sales focus, working closely with the founding team to define and execute our US growth strategy.



Requirements:


What You Bring 

  • 4+ years of experience as an Account Executive in a SaaS company
  • Proven track record selling to CISOs, security teams, or technical buyers in the US market

Builder Experience (Must-Have)

  • Background in early-stage or high-growth startups (not just large enterprises)

Strong Sales Execution

  • Track record of sourcing and closing deals independently
  • Comfortable owning the full sales cycle end-to-end

US Market Expertise

  • Deep understanding of US buyers and sales dynamics
  • Strong local network is a plus

Commercial & Strategic Thinking

  • Ability to identify and develop partnerships (not just manage them)
  • Strong intuition for market opportunities and GTM strategy

Operator Mindset 

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and limited structure
  • Able to build processes, not just follow them

Who You Are

  • Highly proactive and self-directed
  • Energized by building something from zero
  • Commercially sharp and results-driven
  • Comfortable operating as a team of one (initially)
  • Strong communicator with executive presence

What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)

  • Built a strong pipeline in the US
  • Closed initial lighthouse customers
  • Refined ICP and messaging for the US market
  • Identified 1-2 scalable growth channels (e.g., partnerships, outbound motion)
  • Established a clear foundation for hiring the next US team members



Responsibilities:


What You’ll Do 

Grow the US Market 

  • Develop and execute our US go-to-market strategy
  • Identify target segments, ICP, and priority accounts
  • Adapt messaging and positioning for US buyers

Own Revenue End-to-End

  • Generate your own pipeline through outbound, events, and network
  • Run full sales cycles - from first touch to close
  • Close initial deals and build early customer relationships

Develop Strategic Partnerships

  • Identify and test high-value partnership opportunities
  • Build relationships with key ecosystem players
  • Validate and scale channels that drive pipeline

Be the Voice of the Market

  • Provide continuous feedback on product, pricing, and positioning
  • Share insights on competitors and market dynamics
  • Help shape our broader global GTM strategy

Lay the Foundation for Scale

  •  Build repeatable sales processes
  •  Help define when and how to hire AEs, SDRs, and partnership roles
  •  Contribute to building the future US team



Benefits:


Why Join Scytale? 

  • Comprehensive health insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Flexible hybrid work model
  • Flexible paid time off, plus 80 hours of sick time
  • 11 company-paid holidays
  • Commuter and lunch benefits
  • Virtual team-building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events
  • Offices in NYC, Tel Aviv, Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Prague
  • Real opportunities for personal and professional growth
  • Work on an innovative, cutting-edge product shaping the future of security and compliance
  • Learning and growth through courses, conferences, and mentorship
  • A collaborative and supportive team culture

The OTE range for this position is $240,000-$300,000. As part of our commitment to transparency, we share base pay ranges for all US-based roles, regardless of location. These ranges are determined by role, level, and country, and are benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offers are tailored based on candidate location, skills, depth of experience, and relevant qualifications.

Role Overview

We are hiring a full-cycle Account Executive who will own both pipeline generation and closing.

As an early GTM hire, you will have significant ownership, meaningful equity, and a direct role in building our commercial organization from the ground up. You will work closely with founders, engineers, and FDEs to turn early customer traction into a repeatable GTM motion.

This role is for someone who wants to build the sales organization—not inherit an established playbook.

What You’ll Do

  • Build qualified pipeline through outbound
  • Create, run, monitor, and improve outbound sequences
  • Lead discovery and qualification calls
  • Own prospects from initial conversation through pilot, negotiation, and close
  • Partner with FDEs during onboarding, kickoff, and deployment
  • Maintain customer relationships and identify expansion opportunities
  • Develop messaging, sales collateral, qualification criteria, and sales processes
  • Translate customer feedback into useful insights for product and engineering
  • Help shape how we hire, train, and structure the future GTM organization

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently creates and closes qualified pipeline
  • Builds credibility with engineering and technical buyers
  • Moves customers efficiently from discovery through deployment
  • Identifies and closes expansion opportunities
  • Improves the systems and messaging used throughout the sales process
  • Takes ownership beyond an individual revenue target
  • Helps turn early customer traction into a scalable commercial organization

What We’re Looking For

  • At least one year of full-cycle sales experience spanning pipeline generation and closing
  • Personally created outbound pipeline rather than relying entirely on SDRs or inbound
  • Experience selling technical products to engineering or similarly technical buyers
  • Experience selling to startups
  • Familiarity with high-velocity, usage-based, or pay-as-you-go sales motions
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • Ability to operate effectively without an established sales playbook
  • Strong reasoning and the ability to explain why a sales approach succeeded or failed
  • Genuine interest in meaningful ownership, equity, and company-building
  • Willingness to work from our San Francisco office five days per week

Nice to Have

  • Developer tools, infrastructure, data, or AI sales experience
  • Founding AE or early GTM experience
  • Experience working closely with technical implementation or deployment teams
  • Evidence of resilience in difficult or ambiguous environments
  • Independent or unusual thinking

Experience and Seniority

We care more about relevant experience, ownership, learning velocity, and slope than title or total years of experience.

Location

San Francisco, in office five days per week.

Compensation

Competitive base salary, performance-based variable compensation, and meaningful equity.
